topics.name: Articles a / an / the, some / any

options: We is gliding across the lake.

questions.rule: Present continuous: are + verb-ing. We takes are: We are gliding.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence with the correct article.
options: An swallow is flying over the water.
A swallow is flying over the water.
A swallow are flying over the water.
questions.rule: swallow begins with a consonant sound, so use a. One swallow takes is.

options: The kingfisher catch fish every day.
The kingfisher catchs fish every day.
The kingfisher catches fish every day.
questions.rule: With he/she/it, the simple present adds -s or -es. After -ch, add -es: catches.
